question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, e.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, d.CITY, d.STATE, d.POSTAL_CODE FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS d JOIN FCLT_ROOMS a ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY b ON a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = b.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY c ON b.DLC_KEY = c.DLC_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS e ON e.BUILDING_KEY = d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE lower(c.DLC_NAME) = lower('History') AND d.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

candidates.approach: Direct INNER JOIN chain with DISTINCT (street-purpose addresses only)
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY,
  fba.STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
INNER JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY od
  ON od.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
INNER JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh
  ON mdh.DLC_KEY = od.DLC_KEY
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE mdh.DLC_NAME = 'history department'
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

candidates.approach: Semijoin via EXISTS (avoid DISTINCT)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY,
  fba.STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE
FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
INNER JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
    INNER JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY od
      ON od.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
    INNER JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh
      ON mdh.DLC_KEY = od.DLC_KEY
    WHERE r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
      AND mdh.DLC_NAME = 'history department'
  );

question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.activity_title, d.session_location, c.term_start_date, b.person_name AS Leader FROM iap_subject_detail a JOIN iap_subject_person b ON a.iap_subject_person_key = b.iap_subject_person_key JOIN academic_terms_all c ON c.term_code = a.term_code JOIN iap_subject_session d ON a.iap_subject_session_key = d.iap_subject_session_key WHERE b.person_role = 'Activity leader' ORDER BY term_start_date ASC;

candidates.approach: DISTINCT across joined tables
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_LOCATION,
  t.TERM_START_DATE,
  p.PERSON_NAME
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d
INNER JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION AS s
  ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
INNER JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON AS p
  ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
WHERE p.PERSON_ROLE = 'Supervisor'
ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE ASC;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY to enforce uniqueness (no DISTINCT)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_LOCATION,
  t.TERM_START_DATE,
  p.PERSON_NAME
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d
INNER JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION AS s
  ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
INNER JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON AS p
  ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
WHERE p.PERSON_ROLE = 'Supervisor'
GROUP BY
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_LOCATION,
  t.TERM_START_DATE,
  p.PERSON_NAME
ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE ASC;

question: List the unique course instructor names, course titles, and the amount of material for each course instructor key and the key of subject offered.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR.instructor_name, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.subject_title, COUNT(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG.catalog_isbn) OVER (PARTITION BY LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY with COUNT of materials (ISBN)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COUNT(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS amount_of_material,
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

candidates.approach: Window function + DISTINCT (no GROUP BY in outer query)
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COUNT(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) OVER (
    PARTITION BY lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  ) AS amount_of_material,
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY;

candidates.approach: Pre-aggregate in a derived table, then join to dimensions
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  x.amount_of_material,
  x.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  x.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
FROM (
  SELECT
    lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    COUNT(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS amount_of_material
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS lrc
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY
    lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
) AS x
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = x.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = x.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT fac_rooms.Room, fac_rooms.floor, fac_building_address.BUILDING_KEY, BUILDINGS.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fac_building_address.CITY, fac_building_address.STATE, fac_building_address.POSTAL_CODE FROM (SELECT office_location FROM employee_directory WHERE full_name = 'Haynes, Summer') AS emp_office JOIN fac_rooms ON emp_office.office_location = fac_rooms.fac_room_key JOIN fac_building_address ON fac_rooms.building_key = fac_building_address.BUILDING_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS ON BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY = fac_building_address.BUILDING_KEY WHERE fac_building_address.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

candidates.approach: Direct INNER JOIN chain with filter on name and STREET address purpose
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  r.ROOM,
  r.FLOOR,
  a.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE
FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.FAC_ROOM_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE e.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
  AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

candidates.approach: Subquery to isolate the employee office room first, then join to building/address
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  r.ROOM,
  r.FLOOR,
  a.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE
FROM (
  SELECT OFFICE_LOCATION
  FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY
  WHERE FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
) e
INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.FAC_ROOM_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

question: List the unique full room names, their corresponding building names, street addresses, cities, states, postal codes, and building heights for rooms associated with subjects that Computer Science students can enroll in.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON MEET_PLACE = FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

candidates.approach: Straight INNER JOINs with DISTINCT (filter address to STREET)
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  bl.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE,
  fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
INNER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON s.MEET_PLACE = r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
INNER JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
INNER JOIN BUILDINGS bl
  ON bl.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Computer Science';

candidates.approach: Use EXISTS (semi-join) to avoid joining subjects into the rowset
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE,
  fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
INNER JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  WHERE s.MEET_PLACE = r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
    AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Computer Science'
);

question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.TERM_CODE, s.subject_title, fr.room, fr.floor, b.BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, s.form_type, s.num_enrolled_students FROM subject_offered s JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON MEET_PLACE = FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS b ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY WHERE s.num_enrolled_students > 300 AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

candidates.approach: Direct INNER JOINs + DISTINCT
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  so.TERM_CODE,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  r.ROOM,
  r.FLOOR,
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE,
  so.FORM_TYPE,
  so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so
INNER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r
  ON r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
INNER JOIN BUILDINGS AS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS a
  ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 300;

candidates.approach: Window function to enforce uniqueness (dedupe)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  TERM_CODE,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  ROOM,
  FLOOR,
  BUILDING_KEY,
  BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  POSTAL_CODE,
  FORM_TYPE,
  NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM (
  SELECT
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    r.ROOM,
    r.FLOOR,
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    a.POSTAL_CODE,
    so.FORM_TYPE,
    so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        so.TERM_CODE,
        so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        r.ROOM,
        r.FLOOR,
        b.BUILDING_KEY,
        b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
        a.CITY,
        a.STATE,
        a.POSTAL_CODE,
        so.FORM_TYPE,
        so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
      ORDER BY so.TERM_CODE
    ) AS rn
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so
  INNER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r
    ON r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
  INNER JOIN BUILDINGS AS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS a
    ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 300
) AS x
WHERE x.rn = 1;

question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, new shelf prices, and total costs of new materials for each subject title, sorted by individual item prices in ascending order?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tm.title, tm.isbn, tm.new_shelf_price, SUM(tm.new_shelf_price) OVER(PARTITION BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE) FROM tip_material tm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY tm.new_shelf_price ASC;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY aggregate total cost per subject+material
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tm.TITLE,
  tm.ISBN,
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS TOTAL_COST_NEW_MATERIALS
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
INNER JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
INNER JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tm.TITLE,
  tm.ISBN,
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE
ORDER BY
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC;

candidates.approach: Window function total per subject title (repeats per item)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tm.TITLE,
  tm.ISBN,
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS TOTAL_COST_NEW_MATERIALS
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
INNER JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
INNER JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
ORDER BY
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC;

candidates.approach: Correlated subquery to compute total per subject title
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tm.TITLE,
  tm.ISBN,
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  (
    SELECT SUM(tm2.NEW_SHELF_PRICE)
    FROM TIP_DETAIL td2
    INNER JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm2
      ON tm2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
    WHERE td2.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
  ) AS TOTAL_COST_NEW_MATERIALS
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
INNER JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
INNER JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
ORDER BY
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC;

question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.year_built, COUNT(employee_directory.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.year_built) AS num_employees FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM STR_TO_DATE(date_built, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS year_built FROM fclt_building_hist) AS sub1 WHERE year_built < 1950) AS a JOIN fclt_rooms ON fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MIT_ID, OFFICE_LOCATION FROM employee_directory) AS employee_directory ON employee_directory.OFFICE_LOCATION = fclt_rooms.BUILDING_ROOM) AS sub2 WHERE num_employees > 100;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY with joins and HAVING
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS built_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS num_employees
FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
INNER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = e.OFFICE_LOCATION
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) < 1950
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'))
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) > 100;

candidates.approach: Pre-aggregate employee counts per building in a derived table, then join to buildings
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS built_year,
  x.num_employees
FROM (
  SELECT
    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS num_employees
  FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  INNER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = e.OFFICE_LOCATION
  GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
) x
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = x.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) < 1950
  AND x.num_employees > 100;

question: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?
gold_sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.subject_id) FROM cis_course_catalog ccc JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME;

candidates.approach: Straight joins + GROUP BY (count distinct CIS subjects per building)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses
FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb
INNER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr
  ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso
  ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
INNER JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc
  ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
GROUP BY
  fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME;

candidates.approach: Pre-aggregate building-course pairs in a derived table, then join to buildings
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME,
  x.num_courses
FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr
  INNER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso
    ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
  INNER JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc
    ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
) AS x
  ON x.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

candidates.approach: Window function over building-course rows, then de-duplicate buildings
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  t.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  t.BUILDING_NAME,
  t.num_courses
FROM (
  SELECT
    fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS num_courses
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb
  INNER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr

gold_sql: SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS Total_Phone_Numbers, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'U' ELSE 'G' END AS Most_Common_Course_Level FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: What is the building component, name of the building, square footage for all rooms, total number of floors, total number of rooms, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, and total number of supervisees for each building component?
gold_sql: SELECT sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, b.BUILDING_NAME, sd.Total_Square_Footage, COUNT(DISTINCT SF.FLOOR) AS Total_Number_Of_Floors, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms, COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) as Total_Number_FCLT, COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS Total_Supervisors, SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS Total_Supervisees FROM (SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.*, SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_COMPONENT) AS Total_Square_Footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, b.BUILDING_NAME, sd.Total_Square_Footage;

  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY

    COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_rooms
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL
  GROUP BY BUILDING_COMPONENT
) room_agg
  ON room_agg.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    sd2.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_floors
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_COMPONENT, FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd2
  INNER JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd2.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY sd2.BUILDING_COMPONENT
) floor_agg
  ON floor_agg.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT

  SELECT
    sd3.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_COMPONENT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd3
  INNER JOIN SPACE_UNIT su

  GROUP BY sd3.BUILDING_COMPONENT
) org_agg
  ON org_agg.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
INNER JOIN (

    sd4.BUILDING_COMPONENT,

  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_COMPONENT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd4
  INNER JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd4.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  INNER JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
    ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
  GROUP BY sd4.BUILDING_COMPONENT
) sup_agg
  ON sup_agg.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT;

question: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each DLC?
gold_sql: SELECT su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS Total_Number_Of_Floors, sd.Total_Square_Footage, COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Total_Number_Facility, COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS Total_Supervisors, SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS Total_Supervisees, SUM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS Cumulative_Building_Height FROM (SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.*, SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_COMPONENT) AS Total_Square_Footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION) fo ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, sd.Total_Square_Footage;

  x.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  x.total_tip_subject_types,
  x.total_enrolled_students,
  x.min_rental_new_price,
  x.max_rental_new_price
FROM (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tso.SUBJECT_ID)
      + DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tso.SUBJECT_ID DESC)
      - 1 AS total_tip_subject_types,
    SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS total_enrolled_students,
    MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS max_rental_new_price
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  INNER JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
) x;

question: What are the details of courses offered in the current academic term, including the academic year, term code, hgn code, the total number of types of courses, the average number of units, the department name, the name and email address of the person in charge?
gold_sql: SELECT CC.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CC.TERM_CODE, SO.HGN_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT CC.SUBJECT_ID) AS TOTAL_COURSES, AVG(CC.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVERAGE_UNITS, CC.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ED.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ED.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CC JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED SO ON CC.SUBJECT_ID = SO.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AT ON CC.TERM_CODE = AT.TERM_CODE JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ED ON SO.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ED.MIT_ID WHERE AT.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY CC.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CC.TERM_CODE, SO.HGN_CODE, CC.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ED.FULL_NAME, ED.EMAIL_ADDRESS;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY aggregation over current term
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ccso.TERM_CODE,
  so.HGN_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_number_of_types_of_courses,
  AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_number_of_units,
  ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ed.FULL_NAME,
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
INNER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ccso.TERM_CODE,
  so.HGN_CODE,
  ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ed.FULL_NAME,
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS;

candidates.approach: Window functions (no GROUP BY; dedupe with DISTINCT)

SELECT DISTINCT
  ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR,

  COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (
    PARTITION BY
      ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      ccso.TERM_CODE,
      so.HGN_CODE,
      ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      ed.FULL_NAME,
      ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS
  ) AS total_number_of_types_of_courses,
  AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY
      ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      ccso.TERM_CODE,
      so.HGN_CODE,
      ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      ed.FULL_NAME,
      ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS
  ) AS average_number_of_units,
  ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ed.FULL_NAME,
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
INNER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y';

question: Retrieve information about the IAP subjects, including their titles, categories, session titles, session start time, session end time, sponsor names, and total number of sessions.
gold_sql: SELECT isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE, isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, iss.SESSION_TITLE, iss.SESSION_START_TIME, iss.SESSION_END_TIME, isp.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(distinct iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS Total_Sessions FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR isp ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = isp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE, isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, iss.SESSION_TITLE, iss.SESSION_START_TIME, iss.SESSION_END_TIME, isp.SPONSOR_NAME;

INNER JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
INNER JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, and the total number of courses per department.
gold_sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

candidates.sql:
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  s.SUBJECT_CODE,
  s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  c.GRADUATE_LEVEL,
  COUNT(s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
INNER JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c
  ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s
  ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  s.SUBJECT_CODE,
  s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  c.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

    PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, c.GRADUATE_LEVEL
  ) AS total_courses
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
INNER JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c

INNER JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s
  ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE;

 AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = x.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

question: For each term, list the term code, the term description, whether the term is current or not, and the total number of types of CIS courses.
gold_sql: SELECT at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM2, COUNT(DISTINCT at.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_SUBJECTS FROM (SELECT at.*, SUBJECT_ID, CASE WHEN at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_CURRENT_TERM2 FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.*, CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA' THEN 'Y' END AS A, CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%JA' THEN 'Y' END AS B, CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%SP' THEN 'Y' END AS C, CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU' THEN 'Y' END AS D FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL) at LEFT OUTER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND (IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = at.A OR IS_OFFERED_IAP = at.B OR IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = at.C OR IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = at.D)) at GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM2;

candidates.sql:
SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  p.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_cis_course_types
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t
INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p
  ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
CROSS JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  p.IS_CURRENT_TERM;

  ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
INNER JOIN (

question: What is the author, school name, material status, total record counts, and total number of types of courses for each author and school?
gold_sql: SELECT tm.AUTHOR, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS Total_Record_Count , COUNT(distinct td.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN (select TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, CASE WHEN INSTR(AUTHOR, ';') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(AUTHOR, 1, INSTR(AUTHOR, ';') - 1) ELSE AUTHOR END AS AUTHOR FROM TIP_MATERIAL) tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY tm.AUTHOR, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, sd.SCHOOL_NAME;

  tm.AUTHOR AS author,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_record_counts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_course_types
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
INNER JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
INNER JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
INNER JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
INNER JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
GROUP BY
  tm.AUTHOR,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

question: What is the course number, subject title, material status, the total, min, and max new shelf price, the total, min, and max used shelf price, total number of schools and the total number of materials for each TIP subject and material status?

question: What is the term description, whether the term is current or not, total number of types of TIP subjects offered and materials needed, the minimum and maximum number of enrolled students, the total number of schools offering subjects, and the total number of records for each term code?
gold_sql: SELECT at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses, COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS Total_Materials, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Min_Enrolled_Students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Max_Enrolled_Students, COUNT(DISTINCT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS Total_Num_Schools, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS Total_Records FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at LEFT OUTER JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM;

question: For the 2023 Fall term, what are the unique term descriptions, subject titles along with their prerequisites, total number of types of subjects per term code, instructor of this course, and the number of types of courses ever taught by the instructor?

question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the floor area and building.
gold_sql: SELECT fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, ff.FLOOR, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN FLOOR_AREA = 0 THEN 0 ELSE fr.AREA/FLOOR_AREA END AS PERC_OF_FLOOR, CASE WHEN BUILDING_AREA = 0 THEN 0 ELSE fr.AREA/BUILDING_AREA END AS PERC_OF_BUILDING FROM (SELECT ROOM_FULL_NAME, BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR_KEY,ORGANIZATION_KEY, AREA, SUM(AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR_KEY) AS FLOOR_AREA, SUM(AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_AREA FROM FAC_ROOMS) fr JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY;

candidates.approach: Join to pre-aggregated floor/building totals (GROUP BY subqueries)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  f.FLOOR,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) / ft.floor_area) * 100 AS pct_room_over_floor_area,
  (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) / bt.building_area) * 100 AS pct_room_over_building_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS floor_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY
) ft
  ON ft.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS building_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) bt
  ON bt.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY;

question: What are the academic year, and instructors names for courses offered in the academic year 2022, along with the total number of types of courses per instructor?
gold_sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ed.FULL_NAME, COUNT(distinct so.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON so.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ed.FULL_NAME;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY with COUNT(DISTINCT course_number)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_course_types
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED s
INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
GROUP BY
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  e.FULL_NAME;

  e.FULL_NAME,

FROM (
  SELECT
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,

    COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_course_types
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED s
INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
    ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  WHERE t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
  GROUP BY
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
) x
INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON x.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID;

question: What are the building names, department names, organizations, their highest and lowest floor number, along with the total number of rooms per each building key?
gold_sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION, MAX(ff.LEVEL_ID) as MAX_FLOOR, MIN(ff.LEVEL_ID) as MIN_FLOOR, COUNT(distinct fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS Total_Rooms FROM FAC_BUILDING fb JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION;

candidates.approach: Single aggregation with INNER JOINs (GROUP BY)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  o.ORGANIZATION,
  MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS highest_floor_number,
  MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS lowest_floor_number,
  COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS total_number_of_rooms
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  o.ORGANIZATION,
  b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY;

candidates.approach: Pre-aggregate floors and room counts separately, then join the aggregates
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  o.ORGANIZATION,
  fl.highest_floor_number,
  fl.lowest_floor_number,
  rc.total_number_of_rooms
FROM (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS highest_floor_number,
    MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS lowest_floor_number
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  INNER JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
) fl
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS total_number_of_rooms
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  GROUP BY
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
) rc
  ON rc.BUILDING_KEY = fl.BUILDING_KEY
 AND rc.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fl.ORGANIZATION_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fl.BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fl.ORGANIZATION_KEY;

  ) AS highest_floor_number,

question: Provide the complete information for students with the first name Kevin, including their full names, email addresses, department names, department phone numbers, school names, and the total student count per department and school. If a student is associated with more than one department, list a separate row for each department.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msd2.EMAIL_ADDRESS) FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON msd2.DEPARTMENT = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS Total_Students_DEPT, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msd3.EMAIL_ADDRESS) FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd3 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd3 ON msd3.DEPARTMENT = sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd3.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS Total_Students_SCHOOL FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin';

SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME,
  msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS total_student_count_per_department_and_school
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd
INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME,
  msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  cnt.total_student_count_per_department_and_school

  GROUP BY
    sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd2.SCHOOL_CODE
) AS cnt
  ON cnt.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
 AND cnt.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE

question: What are the unique titles of subjects offered in the fall term along with their instructor names, instructor emails, and the total number of types of subjects per instructor?
gold_sql: SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.FULL_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, Total_Subjects.Total_Subjects FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN (SELECT ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA' GROUP BY ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS Total_Subjects ON e.MIT_ID = Total_Subjects.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WHERE at.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA' GROUP BY ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.FULL_NAME, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, Total_Subjects.Total_Subjects;

candidates.approach: DISTINCT titles + window count of distinct subjects per instructor
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY e.MIT_ID) AS total_subject_types_per_instructor
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c
INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS e
  ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y';

candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  s.total_subject_types_per_instructor
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c
INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS e
  ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subject_types_per_instructor
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  WHERE IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
) AS s
  ON s.MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y';

question: List the building names, names of HR departments occupying them, the total gross square footage, the total and average assignable square footage, and the built year per building key.
gold_sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS Total_Gross_Sq_Ft, SUM(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS Total_Assignable_Sq_Ft, AVG(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS Avg_Assignable_Sq_Ft, YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(fb.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS Year_Built FROM BUILDINGS b JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fb.DATE_BUILT;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY over joined rooms (dept list + building sums)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SUM(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_gross_square_footage,
  SUM(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_assignable_square_footage,
  AVG(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_assignable_square_footage,
  fb.DATE_BUILT AS built_year
FROM BUILDINGS b
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.DATE_BUILT;

candidates.approach: Pre-aggregate departments per building in a derived table, then join to building facts
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS total_gross_square_footage,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS total_assignable_square_footage,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS avg_assignable_square_footage,
  fb.DATE_BUILT AS built_year
FROM BUILDINGS b
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN (

  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  INNER JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
) AS d
  ON d.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY;

  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME)

  SUM(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)
    OVER (PARTITION BY b.BUILDING_KEY) AS total_gross_square_footage,

question: Retrieve the titles of subjects offered in the summer term along with their descriptions, responsible faculty names, email address, building name, room name, floor level, building street address, and the total number of types of courses per departmnet.

  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS,

  dc.total_course_types_per_department

question: List building names, their height, street address, city, state, postal code, their gross and assignable square footage, the smallest and largest floor level and the total area of all rooms for each building key.

candidates.approach: Window functions over joined detail, then DISTINCT to one row per status/term
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  x.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  x.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  x.TERM_CODE,
  x.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  x.total_number_of_courses,
  x.total_number_of_materials,
  x.occurrences_in_departments,
  x.occurrences_in_school,
  x.total_number_of_instructors
FROM
(
  SELECT
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    lso.TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lso.COURSE_NUMBER
    )
    + DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lso.COURSE_NUMBER DESC
    ) - 1 AS total_number_of_courses,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER
    )
    + DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER DESC
    ) - 1 AS total_number_of_materials,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
    )
    + DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE DESC
    ) - 1 AS occurrences_in_departments,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
    )
    + DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME DESC
    ) - 1 AS occurrences_in_school,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
    )
    + DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lso.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME DESC
    ) - 1 AS total_number_of_instructors
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

    ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
    ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY

question: For building 36, list all space units, their floor and building name, building street address, their space usage, and the number of organizations and space units on the same building and floor.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT, sf.FLOOR, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, su2.SPACE_USAGE, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) FROM SPACE_UNIT su2 JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd2 ON su2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo2 ON fo2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY) AS Total_Organizations, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT su3.SPACE_UNIT) FROM SPACE_UNIT su3 JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd3 ON su3.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd3.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd3.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd3.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY) AS Total_Space_Units FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN SPACE_USAGE su2 ON su2.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER = 36;

question: For each distinct mailing list containing more than 1000 people and with a name starting with A (case insensitive), provide its name, whether it is a mailing list, whether it is a moira group, whether it is a NFS group, the owner of the mailing list, and the number of people in the list.
gold_sql: SELECT ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST, ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP, ml.IS_NFS_GROUP, mlo.OWNER, member_counts.occurrences FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY JOIN ( SELECT mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS occurrences FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY HAVING COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 1000 ) member_counts ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = member_counts.MOIRA_LIST_KEY WHERE upper(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'A%';

candidates.approach: GROUP BY with HAVING (single pass aggregation)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP,
  mlo.OWNER,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS people_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST AS ml
INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER AS mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'A%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP,
  mlo.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 1000;

question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.
gold_sql: WITH Occurrences AS ( SELECT mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY, COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS occurrences FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY ) SELECT DISTINCT ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mlo.OWNER, ml.IS_PUBLIC, ml.IS_HIDDEN, o.occurrences FROM Occurrences o JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml ON o.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo ON O.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY WHERE o.occurrences = (SELECT MIN(occurrences) FROM Occurrences) OR o.occurrences = (SELECT MAX(occurrences) FROM Occurrences);

candidates.approach: Correlated subqueries for min/max, then join to owners
candidates.sql:
SELECT
    mc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mlo.OWNER,
    mc.IS_PUBLIC,
    mc.IS_HIDDEN,
    mc.member_count
FROM (
  SELECT
      ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
      ml.IS_PUBLIC,
      ml.IS_HIDDEN,
      COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  GROUP BY
      ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
      ml.IS_PUBLIC,
      ml.IS_HIDDEN
) mc
INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE mc.member_count = (
        SELECT MIN(t.member_count)
        FROM (
          SELECT COUNT(mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
          FROM MOIRA_LIST ml2
          INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld2
            ON mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
          WHERE ml2.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
          GROUP BY ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
        ) t
      )
   OR mc.member_count = (
        SELECT MAX(t.member_count)
        FROM (
          SELECT COUNT(mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
          FROM MOIRA_LIST ml2
          INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld2
            ON mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
          WHERE ml2.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
          GROUP BY ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
        ) t
      )
ORDER BY mc.member_count, mc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mlo.OWNER;

question: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.
gold_sql: WITH FilteredLists AS ( SELECT ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME FROM MOIRA_LIST ml WHERE upper(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'C%' ) SELECT DISTINCT fl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS Moira_List_Name, COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS Member_Count, COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS Distinct_Faculty_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON UPPER(ed.KRB_NAME) = UPPER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) JOIN FilteredLists fl ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU' AND CAST(at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) > 2001 GROUP BY fl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

candidates.approach: Aggregate list members, then join to faculty-who-taught-in-summer set
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS people_in_list,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS faculty_in_list
FROM MOIRA_LIST AS ml
INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso
  INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE
  WHERE at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > '2001'
    AND UPPER(at.TERM_CODE) LIKE '%SU%'
) AS summer_fac
  ON summer_fac.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
WHERE UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'C%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

candidates.sql:
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mld1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
   FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld1
   WHERE mld1.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  ) AS people_in_list,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID)
   FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld2
   INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed
     ON ed.MIT_ID = mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
   INNER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso
     ON cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
   INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at
     ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE
   WHERE mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
     AND at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > '2001'
     AND UPPER(at.TERM_CODE) LIKE '%SU%'
  ) AS faculty_in_list
FROM MOIRA_LIST AS ml
WHERE UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'C%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mldx
    INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS edx
      ON edx.MIT_ID = mldx.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
    INNER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS csox

question: For each mailing list with a name beginning with R (case insensitive), and that Professor Ayden Hopkins is subscribed to, list its name, description, owner, number of people in the list, and number of tenured faculty in the list.

question: For the building with the most floors, list the building name and the names of the mailing lists staring with a (case insensitive) that the building employees with kerberos starting with c (case insensitive) subscribe to.
gold_sql: WITH FilteredMoiraLists AS ( SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME FROM MOIRA_LIST WHERE MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'a%' ), FilteredMoiraListDetails AS ( SELECT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld JOIN FilteredMoiraLists fml ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY ), FloorsWithLevels AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(ff.LEVEL_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.BUILDING_KEY) AS MAX_LEVEL, MIN(ff.LEVEL_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_LEVEL FROM FAC_BUILDING fb JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY ), FloorsPerBuilding AS ( SELECT BUILDING_NAME, MAX_LEVEL - MIN_LEVEL + 1 AS NUM_FLOORS FROM FloorsWithLevels GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, MAX_LEVEL, MIN_LEVEL ), MaxFloors AS ( SELECT MAX(NUM_FLOORS) AS MAX_FLOORS FROM FloorsPerBuilding ), BuildingWithMostFloors AS ( SELECT a.BUILDING_NAME FROM FloorsPerBuilding a JOIN MaxFloors b ON a.NUM_FLOORS = b.MAX_FLOORS ), EmployeesInTallestBuildings AS ( SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(e.KRB_NAME) AS KRB_NAME, fb.building_name FROM BuildingWithMostFloors b JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb ON b.BUILDING_NAME = fb.BUILDING_NAME JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY WHERE upper(e.KRB_NAME) LIKE 'C%' ) SELECT DISTINCT etb.BUILDING_NAME, fml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME FROM EmployeesInTallestBuildings etb JOIN FilteredMoiraListDetails fmld ON UPPER(etb.KRB_NAME) = UPPER(fmld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) JOIN FilteredMoiraLists fml ON fmld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY;

question: For the email lists subscribed by faculty members with last names begin with Y, list the names of the lists, the total number of subjects managed by faculty in those mailing lists, and the number of such faculty in the lists.

INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e

    INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld

    WHERE mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

Provide the department name, phone number, and the total number of students subscribed to the mailing list from that department. If multiple departments have the same highest count, list each one separately.
gold_sql: WITH FilteredList AS ( SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME FROM MOIRA_LIST WHERE MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'ocean-apple' ), FilteredListDetails AS ( SELECT mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld JOIN FilteredList fl ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY ), StudentMemberCounts AS ( SELECT fl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, fl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_members FROM FilteredList fl JOIN FilteredListDetails fld ON fl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY JOIN SE_PERSON se ON UPPER(fld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = UPPER(se.KRB_NAME) JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON se.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY fl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, fl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RankedDepartments AS ( SELECT department_name, department_phone, SUM(student_members) AS total_student_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(student_members) DESC) AS department_rank FROM StudentMemberCounts GROUP BY department_name, department_phone ) SELECT department_name AS most_prominent_dpt, department_phone AS most_prominent_dpt_phone, total_student_members FROM RankedDepartments WHERE department_rank = 1;

question: For each mailing list, list its owner, owner type, the member visibility ('Public Members' if public, and 'Hidden Members' otherwise), and the number of members of this type of visibility. For each owner and owner type, include a grand total for all members in the format of (owner, owner type, null, total members).
gold_sql: WITH MemberVisibility AS ( SELECT mo.OWNER, mo.OWNER_TYPE, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, CASE WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'N' THEN 'Hidden Members' ELSE NULL END AS member_visibility, COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_members FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mo ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'Y' AND upper(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY mo.OWNER, mo.OWNER_TYPE, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ml.IS_PUBLIC ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT MOIRA_LIST_NAME, member_visibility, SUM(total_members) AS total_members FROM MemberVisibility GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_NAME, member_visibility WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_members) > 0 ) SELECT rr.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mv.OWNER, mv.OWNER_TYPE, rr.member_visibility, rr.total_members FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_NAME, OWNER, OWNER_TYPE FROM MemberVisibility) mv ON rr.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = mv.MOIRA_LIST_NAME ORDER BY rr.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, rr.member_visibility;

question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. gold_sql: WITH EnrollmentWithAnalytics AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.CLUSTER_TYPE) AS avg_enrollment_in_cluster, scd.COURSE_LEVEL FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' ), EnrollmentWithTIP AS ( SELECT ewa.SUBJECT_ID, ewa.SUBJECT_TITLE, ewa.DEPARTMENT, ewa.CLUSTER_TYPE, ewa.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ewa.avg_enrollment_in_cluster, ewa.COURSE_LEVEL, tm.TITLE AS material_title, tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE, td.RECORD_COUNT AS material_record_count FROM EnrollmentWithAnalytics ewa LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON ewa.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ), EnrollmentWithLibrary AS ( SELECT ewt.SUBJECT_ID, ewt.SUBJECT_TITLE, ewt.DEPARTMENT, ewt.CLUSTER_TYPE, ewt.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ewt.avg_enrollment_in_cluster, ewt.COURSE_LEVEL, ewt.material_title, ewt.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, ewt.USED_SHELF_PRICE, ewt.material_record_count, lrc.CATALOG_TITLE AS library_title, lrc.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME AS library_author, lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS library_isbn FROM EnrollmentWithTIP ewt LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc ON ewt.SUBJECT_ID = lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER ) SELECT DEPARTMENT, SUBJECT_TITLE, CLUSTER_TYPE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, AVG(avg_enrollment_in_cluster) AS avg_enrollment_in_cluster, COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT material_title) AS num_unique_materials, AVG(NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_material_price, AVG(USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_material_price, SUM(material_record_count) AS total_material_records, COUNT(DISTINCT library_title) AS num_unique_library_titles, COUNT(DISTINCT library_isbn) AS num_unique_library_isbns FROM EnrollmentWithLibrary GROUP BY DEPARTMENT, SUBJECT_TITLE, CLUSTER_TYPE, COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY DEPARTMENT, SUBJECT_TITLE, CLUSTER_TYPE;

question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.

    ON t.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE
  INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  INNER JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.COURSE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      cso2.SUBJECT_ID,
      cso2.TERM_CODE,
      COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(fj.instructor), '')) AS fall_instructor_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(sj.instructor), '')) AS spring_instructor_count
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2
    INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE(
      CONCAT(
        '["',
        REPLACE(REPLACE(IFNULL(cso2.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,''), '"', '\"'), ', ', '","'),
        '"]'
      ),
      '$[*]' COLUMNS (instructor VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')
    ) AS fj
    INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE(
      CONCAT(
        '["',
        REPLACE(REPLACE(IFNULL(cso2.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,''), '"', '\"'), ', ', '","'),
        '"]'
      ),
      '$[*]' COLUMNS (instructor VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')
    ) AS sj
    GROUP BY cso2.SUBJECT_ID, cso2.TERM_CODE
  ) ic
    ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID
   AND ic.TERM_CODE  = cso.TERM_CODE
  WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
    AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y'
) AS x;

question: For Political Science courses with HASS attributes, for each attribute, list the name and description of the attribute, the number of unique subjects, average units, the total enrollment, the number of departments that grant degrees, and the subject code description.
gold_sql: WITH HASSAttributes AS (SELECT cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, cc.SUBJECT_ID, cc.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG cc JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cc.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON cc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT HASS_ATTRIBUTE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN DEPARTMENT_NAME END) AS num_degree_granting, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM HASSAttributes GROUP BY HASS_ATTRIBUTE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY HASS_ATTRIBUTE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

  SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN d.DEPARTMENT_CODE END) AS degree_granting_departments,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AS subject_code_description
FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
INNER JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
  ON c.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE

WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,

question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. question: Group classes that take place in buildings at MIT by the building name and course level. For each group, provide the name of the building, the course level ('Graduate' or 'Undergraduate'), the total number of unique courses of such level, and total instructors for these courses. Include subtotals for each building and course level and a grand total across all buildings and course levels.
gold_sql: SELECT ba.BUILDING_NAME, ba.course_level, ba.unique_courses, ba.total_instructors FROM (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'Graduate' WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'Undergraduate' ELSE 'Other' END AS course_level, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_courses, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)) OVER (PARTITION BY b.BUILDING_NAME) AS total_instructors FROM FAC_BUILDING b JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = s.MEET_PLACE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = ba.BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) ba ORDER BY ba.unique_courses DESC, ba.BUILDING_NAME;

    WHEN fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Grand Total'
    ELSE fb.BUILDING_NAME
  END AS building_name,

    WHEN fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL IS NULL THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'Graduate'
    WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'Undergraduate'
    ELSE scd.COURSE_LEVEL
  END AS course_level,

INNER JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON so.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE

GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.

question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').
gold_sql: WITH MaterialUsage AS ( SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_catalog_items, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms ON lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc ON lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lrd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON lso.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lrc.CATALOG_YEAR >= 2000 GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MaterialSubtotals AS ( SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, NULL AS department, SUM(num_catalog_items) AS total_catalog_items, SUM(total_students) AS total_students FROM MaterialUsage GROUP BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS ), MaterialGrandTotal AS ( SELECT 'Grand Total' AS LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, NULL AS department, SUM(num_catalog_items) AS total_catalog_items, SUM(total_students) AS total_students FROM MaterialUsage ), MaterialCombined AS ( SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, department, num_catalog_items, total_students FROM MaterialUsage UNION ALL SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, department, total_catalog_items, total_students FROM MaterialSubtotals UNION ALL SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, department, total_catalog_items, total_students FROM MaterialGrandTotal ) SELECT COALESCE(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Subtotal') AS library_material_status, department, num_catalog_items, total_students FROM MaterialCombined ORDER BY CASE WHEN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 WHEN department IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, department;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS IS NULL THEN 'Grand Total'
    ELSE ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
  END AS material_status,
  sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_catalog_items,
  SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL md
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS ms

question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. SortOrder, NULL AS Building_Name, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS Room, NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE, NULL AS Organization_Name, SUM(Total_Rooms) AS Total_Rooms, SUM(Total_Area) AS Total_Area, 100 AS Percent_Of_Total FROM (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS Building_Name, f.FLOOR, r.BUILDING_ROOM AS Room, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Total_Rooms, SUM(r.AREA) AS Total_Area, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Organization_Name, (SELECT SUM(r2.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS r2 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f2 ON r2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE f2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS Building_Total_Area, (SELECT SUM(r3.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS r3) AS Overall_Total_Area FROM FCLT_FLOOR f LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, f.FLOOR, r.BUILDING_ROOM, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS FloorStats WHERE Building_Name IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS SortOrder, Building_Name, FLOOR, Room, OWNERSHIP_TYPE, Organization_Name, Total_Rooms, Total_Area, CASE WHEN FLOOR IS NOT NULL AND Building_Total_Area > 0 THEN ROUND(Total_Area * 100.0 / Building_Total_Area, 2) WHEN FLOOR IS NULL AND Building_Name IS NOT NULL AND Overall_Total_Area > 0 THEN ROUND(Total_Area * 100.0 / Overall_Total_Area, 2) ELSE NULL END AS Percent_Of_Total FROM (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS Building_Name, f.FLOOR, r.BUILDING_ROOM AS Room, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Total_Rooms, SUM(r.AREA) AS Total_Area, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Organization_Name, (SELECT SUM(r2.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS r2 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f2 ON r2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE f2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS Building_Total_Area, (SELECT SUM(r3.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS r3) AS Overall_Total_Area FROM FCLT_FLOOR f LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, f.FLOOR, r.BUILDING_ROOM, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WITH ROLLUP) AS RollupWithPercentages WHERE Building_Name IS NOT NULL) AS AllData ORDER BY SortOrder, Building_Name, FLOOR, Room;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) = 0 THEN r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
    WHEN GROUPING(b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(f.FLOOR) = 0 THEN 'FLOOR SUBTOTAL'
    WHEN GROUPING(b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 THEN 'BUILDING SUBTOTAL'
    ELSE 'GRAND TOTAL'
  END AS room,
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) = 0 THEN r.BUILDING_ROOM
    ELSE NULL
  END AS room_number,
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) = 0 THEN o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
    ELSE NULL
  END AS organization_name,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY), 0), 0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(r.AREA), 0), 0) AS area,
  ROUND(
    100 * SUM(r.AREA) / CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(f.FLOOR) = 0 AND GROUPING(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) = 1
        THEN (SELECT SUM(r2.AREA)
              FROM FCLT_ROOMS r2
              INNER JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f2 ON f2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
              WHERE f2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)
      WHEN GROUPING(b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(f.FLOOR) = 1 AND GROUPING(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) = 1
        THEN (SELECT SUM(r3.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS r3)
      WHEN GROUPING(b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1
        THEN (SELECT SUM(r4.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS r4)
      ELSE (SELECT SUM(r5.AREA)
            FROM FCLT_ROOMS r5
            INNER JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f5 ON f5.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r5.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
            WHERE f5.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)
    END,
    2
  ) AS area_pct_relative
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
INNER JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f
  ON f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
INNER JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  f.FLOOR,
  r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each financial aid year and academic year, list the number of fiscal periods, quarters, the start term date, the end term date, and number of distinct department-level term parameters.
gold_sql: WITH FinancialAidDetails AS ( SELECT at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, td.START_DATE AS Term_Start_Date, td.END_DATE AS Term_End_Date, tm.FISCAL_PERIOD, tm.FISCAL_YEAR, tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE, tp.TERM_PARAMETER AS Dept_Term_Param FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN TIME_DAY td ON at.TERM_START_DATE = td.CALENDAR_DATE JOIN TIME_MONTH tm ON td.FISCAL_PERIOD = tm.FISCAL_PERIOD AND td.FISCAL_YEAR = tm.FISCAL_YEAR JOIN TIME_QUARTER tq ON tm.FISCAL_YEAR = tq.FISCAL_YEAR AND tm.FY_QUARTER_CODE = tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER tp ON at.TERM_CODE = tp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR IS NOT NULL ) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT FISCAL_PERIOD) AS Total_Fiscal_Periods, COUNT(DISTINCT FY_QUARTER_CODE) AS Total_Quarters, MIN(Term_Start_Date) AS First_Term_Start_Date, MAX(Term_End_Date) AS Last_Term_End_Date, COUNT(DISTINCT Dept_Term_Param) AS Distinct_Term_Params FROM FinancialAidDetails GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR DESC, ACADEMIC_YEAR ASC;

  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,

  COUNT(DISTINCT tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE) AS num_quarters,
  MIN(td.START_DATE) AS start_term_date,
  MAX(td.END_DATE) AS end_term_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT atp.TERM_PARAMETER) AS num_distinct_dept_level_term_parameters
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
INNER JOIN TIME_DAY td
  ON at.TERM_START_DATE = td.CALENDAR_DATE
INNER JOIN TIME_MONTH tm
  ON td.FISCAL_PERIOD = tm.FISCAL_PERIOD
INNER JOIN TIME_QUARTER tq
  ON tq.FISCAL_YEAR = tm.FISCAL_YEAR
INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp
  ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

1 ELSE NULL END AS Adjusted_Sector_Rank FROM RollupRows rr LEFT JOIN TotalRooms tr ON rr.Building_Name = tr.Building_Name LEFT JOIN TotalOrganizations toz ON rr.Building_Name = toz.Building_Name LEFT JOIN BuildingDetails bd ON rr.Building_Name = bd.Building_Name WHERE rr.CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NOT NULL ), GrandTotal AS ( SELECT NULL AS Campus_Sector, NULL AS Building_Name, NULL AS Building_City, NULL AS Building_State, SUM(Total_Floors) AS Total_Floors, SUM(Assignable_Area) AS Assignable_Area, NULL AS Total_Rooms, NULL AS Total_Organizations, NULL AS Ownership_Type, 1 AS Adjusted_Sector_Rank FROM RankedRows ) SELECT Campus_Sector, Building_Name, Building_City, Building_State, Total_Floors, FORMAT(Assignable_Area, 0) AS Assignable_Area, Total_Rooms, Total_Organizations, Ownership_Type, Adjusted_Sector_Rank FROM RankedRows UNION ALL SELECT Campus_Sector, Building_Name, NULL AS Building_City, NULL AS Building_State, Total_Floors, FORMAT(Assignable_Area, 0) AS Assignable_Area, NULL AS Total_Rooms, NULL AS Total_Organizations, Ownership_Type, Adjusted_Sector_Rank FROM GrandTotal ORDER BY Campus_Sector, Adjusted_Sector_Rank, Building_Name;

lrc JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ) SELECT DISTINCT tm.TIP_Department AS Department, tm.TIP_Title, tm.TIP_ISBN,
