question: For each department and material status, list the name of the department, the material status, the number of TIP materials associated with this department and status, the number of library materials associated with this department and status, the total number of TIP and library materials associated with this department and status. Include a subtotal for each department and a grand total across all departments.
gold_sql: WITH TIPMaterialStatuses AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Department, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS Status, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS Total_TIP_Materials FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ), LibraryMaterialStatuses AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Department, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS Status, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS Total_Library_Materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS ), CombinedStatuses AS ( SELECT Department, Status, Total_TIP_Materials, 0 AS Total_Library_Materials FROM TIPMaterialStatuses UNION ALL SELECT Department, Status, 0 AS Total_TIP_Materials, Total_Library_Materials FROM LibraryMaterialStatuses ) SELECT Department, Status, SUM(Total_TIP_Materials) AS Total_TIP_Materials, SUM(Total_Library_Materials) AS Total_Library_Materials, SUM(Total_TIP_Materials + Total_Library_Materials) AS Total_All_Materials FROM CombinedStatuses GROUP BY Department, Status WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY Department, Status;

    assignable_status,
    major_use_description,

             GROUP BY r2.BUILDING_KEY, r2.FLOOR_KEY
           ) t2)
        ELSE
          -- detail row: average area per room on that floor
          AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)))
      END
    , 0)
  , 0) AS average_area_per_floor,
  CASE WHEN r.FLOOR_KEY IS NULL OR r.BUILDING_KEY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_name,
  CASE WHEN r.FLOOR_KEY IS NULL OR r.BUILDING_KEY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME END AS access_level,
  CASE WHEN r.FLOOR_KEY IS NULL OR r.BUILDING_KEY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE a.POSTAL_CODE END AS zip_code,
  CASE WHEN r.FLOOR_KEY IS NULL OR r.BUILDING_KEY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE a.CITY END AS city
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
INNER JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR_KEY, SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_floor_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR_KEY
) AS floor_tot
  ON floor_tot.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
 AND floor_tot.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DEPARTMENT OF FACILITIES'
GROUP BY
  r.BUILDING_KEY, r.FLOOR_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
  a.POSTAL_CODE, a.CITY
WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each mailing list that involves subscribers that work in departments with names starting with 'Computer Science', state the ownership type, the list name, the number of owners, and the number of subscribers. Display the ownership type only if it differs from the previous entry. Include subtotals (the corresponding type field shoud be 'SUBTOTAL') for each ownership type and a grand total (the corresponding type field shoud be 'TOTAL') across all ownership types.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(OWNERSHIP_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE_gr DESC, ML) = OWNERSHIP_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE OWNERSHIP_TYPE END AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE, ML, nr_owner, nr_member FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN OWNER_TYPE IS NULL AND MOIRA_LIST_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(OWNER_TYPE, '1') ELSE CONCAT(OWNER_TYPE, '2') END AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE_gr, CASE WHEN MOIRA_LIST_NAME IS NULL AND OWNER_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN MOIRA_LIST_NAME IS NULL AND OWNER_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OWNER_TYPE END AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE, MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS ML, COUNT(DISTINCT OWNER) AS nr_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS nr_member FROM MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE department_name LIKE 'Computer Science%' GROUP BY OWNER_TYPE, MOIRA_LIST_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY OWNER_TYPE DESC, MOIRA_LIST_NAME) tbltmp;

WITH per_list AS (
  SELECT
      o.OWNER_TYPE,
      l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
      COUNT(DISTINCT o.OWNER) AS num_owners,
      COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS num_subscribers
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
    ON e.MIT_ID = d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST l
    ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o
    ON o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  WHERE e.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'Computer Science%'
  GROUP BY o.OWNER_TYPE, l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
rolled AS (
  SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN OWNER_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
        WHEN MOIRA_LIST_NAME IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
        ELSE OWNER_TYPE
      END AS type_field,
      MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
      SUM(num_owners) AS num_owners,
      SUM(num_subscribers) AS num_subscribers,
      OWNER_TYPE AS raw_owner_type,
      (MOIRA_LIST_NAME IS NULL) AS is_subtotal,
      (OWNER_TYPE IS NULL) AS is_total
  FROM per_list
  GROUP BY OWNER_TYPE, MOIRA_LIST_NAME WITH ROLLUP
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
      type_field,
      MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
      num_owners,
      num_subscribers,
      raw_owner_type,
      is_subtotal,
      is_total,
      CASE
        WHEN type_field IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END AS is_summary
  FROM rolled
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN type_field IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN type_field
    WHEN raw_owner_type = LAG(raw_owner_type) OVER (
           ORDER BY raw_owner_type, is_summary, MOIRA_LIST_NAME
         )
      THEN NULL
    ELSE raw_owner_type
  END AS OWNER_TYPE,
  MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  num_owners AS NUMBER_OF_OWNERS,
  num_subscribers AS NUMBER_OF_SUBSCRIBERS
FROM final_rows
ORDER BY
  raw_owner_type,
  is_summary,              -- details first, then SUBTOTAL within each type
  MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

question: Group spaces in the Stata building by the access level and usage type. For each group, state the access level, usage type, name of the space, the number of spaces, total area across all rooms in the space, and average area across all rooms in the space. Display the access level only if it differs from the previous entry. Include subtotals for each access level, usage type, and space name, subtotals for each access level, and a grand total across all access levels. Exclude usage type that includes "STORAGE". All numerical values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(assign) OVER (ORDER BY assign) = assign THEN NULL ELSE assign END AS assign, CASE WHEN LAG(muse) OVER (ORDER BY assign, muse_sort) = muse THEN NULL ELSE muse END AS muse, rmuse, rmcnt, area, area_avg FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN ACCESS_LEVEL IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL END AS assign, CASE WHEN su2.SPACE_USAGE IS NULL AND ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE su2.SPACE_USAGE END AS muse, CASE WHEN su2.SPACE_USAGE IS NULL AND ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL THEN 'zzz' ELSE su2.SPACE_USAGE END AS muse_sort, CASE WHEN DLC_NAME IS NULL AND su2.SPACE_USAGE IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS rmuse, CASE WHEN DLC_NAME IS NULL AND su2.SPACE_USAGE IS NOT NULL THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS rmuse_sort, FORMAT(COUNT(DISTINCT SPACE_UNIT), 0) AS rmcnt, FORMAT(SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE), 0) AS area, FORMAT(AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE), 0) AS area_avg FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN (SELECT * FROM SPACE_DETAIL WHERE BUILDING_KEY = '32') sd ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN SPACE_USAGE su2 ON su2.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY JOIN (SELECT * FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE BUILDING_COMPONENT = '32') zrl ON zrl.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE su2.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY ACCESS_LEVEL, su2.SPACE_USAGE, DLC_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY assign, muse_sort, rmuse_sort) tbltmp;

    WHEN GROUPING(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) = 1 THEN NULL
    WHEN z.ACCESS_LEVEL = LAG(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (
           ORDER BY z.ACCESS_LEVEL, u.SPACE_USAGE, o.DLC_NAME
         ) THEN NULL
    ELSE z.ACCESS_LEVEL
  END AS access_level,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(u.SPACE_USAGE) = 1 AND GROUPING(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) = 0 THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN GROUPING(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'Grand Total'
    ELSE u.SPACE_USAGE
  END AS usage_type,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(o.DLC_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) = 0 THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN GROUPING(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'Grand Total'
    ELSE o.DLC_NAME
  END AS space_name,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COUNT(*), 0), 0)                       AS number_of_spaces,
  FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE), 0), 0)    AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE), 0), 0)    AS average_area
FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
INNER JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z
        ON z.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
INNER JOIN SPACE_USAGE u
        ON u.SPACE_USAGE = z.SPACE_USAGE
INNER JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
        ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: Group courses in the biology and chemistry department by whether they are current or not and the cluster type. For each group, list the current status ('CURRENT' if yes and 'NON-CURRENT' otherwise), cluster type, the maximum duration of courses (in terms of days), the maximum units, average duration (in terms of days), and average units. Include subtotals for each current status (the corresponding current status field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all current status (the corresponding current status field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the current status if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by current status and cluster type.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(assign) OVER (ORDER BY IS_CURRENT_TERM DESC, assign, CLUSTER_TYPE ASC) = assign THEN NULL ELSE assign END AS assign, CLUSTER_TYPE, max_duration, max_units, avg_dur, avg_unit FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(CLUSTER_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(CLUSTER_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END END AS assign, IS_CURRENT_TERM, CLUSTER_TYPE, MAX(DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(term_end_date, '%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(term_start_date, '%d-%b-%y'))) AS max_duration, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units, AVG(DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(term_end_date, '%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(term_start_date, '%d-%b-%y'))) AS avg_dur, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_unit FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND ss.department_name IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY IS_CURRENT_TERM, CLUSTER_TYPE WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY IS_CURRENT_TERM DESC, assign, CLUSTER_TYPE ASC ) tbltmp;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY with UNION ALL for subtotals and grand total
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN @prev_status = x.current_status THEN NULL
    ELSE x.current_status
  END AS current_status,
  x.cluster_type,
  x.max_duration_days,
  x.max_units,
  x.avg_duration_days,
  x.avg_units,
  @prev_status := x.current_status AS _set_prev_status
FROM (
  SELECT
    y.current_status,
    y.cluster_type,
    y.max_duration_days,
    y.max_units,
    y.avg_duration_days,
    y.avg_units
  FROM (
    /* Detail by current status + cluster type */
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END AS current_status,
      s.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
      MAX(DATEDIFF(t.TERM_END_DATE, t.TERM_START_DATE)) AS max_duration_days,
      MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units,
      AVG(DATEDIFF(t.TERM_END_DATE, t.TERM_START_DATE)) AS avg_duration_days,
      AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units
    FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
    INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
      ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
    WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
    GROUP BY
      CASE WHEN t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END,
      s.CLUSTER_TYPE

    UNION ALL

    /* Subtotal by current status */
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END AS current_status,
      'SUBTOTAL' AS cluster_type,
      MAX(DATEDIFF(t.TERM_END_DATE, t.TERM_START_DATE)) AS max_duration_days,
      MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units,
      AVG(DATEDIFF(t.TERM_END_DATE, t.TERM_START_DATE)) AS avg_duration_days,
      AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units
    FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
    INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
      ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
    WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
    GROUP BY
      CASE WHEN t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END

    UNION ALL

    /* Grand total */
    SELECT
      'TOTAL' AS current_status,
      'SUBTOTAL' AS cluster_type,
      MAX(DATEDIFF(t.TERM_END_DATE, t.TERM_START_DATE)) AS max_duration_days,
      MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units,
      AVG(DATEDIFF(t.TERM_END_DATE, t.TERM_START_DATE)) AS avg_duration_days,
      AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units
    FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
    INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
      ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
    WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
  ) y
) x
CROSS JOIN (SELECT @prev_status := '') init
ORDER BY
  FIELD(x.current_status, 'CURRENT', 'NON-CURRENT', 'TOTAL'),
  CASE WHEN x.cluster_type = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  x.cluster_type;

gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(assign) OVER (ORDER BY IS_CURRENT_TERM DESC, assign, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ASC) = assign THEN NULL ELSE assign END AS assign, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, max_duration, max_units, avg_dur, avg_unit FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END END AS assign, IS_CURRENT_TERM, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(term_end_date, '%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(term_start_date, '%d-%b-%y'))) AS max_duration, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units, AVG(DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(term_end_date, '%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(term_start_date, '%d-%b-%y'))) AS avg_dur, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_unit FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.offer_dept_name IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY IS_CURRENT_TERM, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY IS_CURRENT_TERM DESC, assign, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ASC) tbltmp;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END AS current_status,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    DATEDIFF(at.TERM_END_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE) AS duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    department_name,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, department_name
),
subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    'SUBTOTAL' AS current_status,
    department_name,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY department_name
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS current_status,
    NULL AS department_name,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
),
all_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    department_name,
    max_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_duration_days,
    avg_units,
    CASE current_status
      WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 1
      WHEN 'NON-CURRENT' THEN 2
      WHEN 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 3
      WHEN 'TOTAL' THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END AS status_sort
  FROM all_rows
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN current_status = LAG(current_status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, department_name)
    THEN NULL
    ELSE current_status
  END AS current_status,
  department_name,
  max_duration_days,
  max_units,
  avg_duration_days,
  avg_units
FROM ordered
ORDER BY status_sort, department_name;

question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of courses, average number of equivalent subjects, the school name, and department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG(CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END) AS avgeqisub FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

      c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department,

      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
          ELSE 1 + LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', ''))
        END

    ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

      SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
      AVG(avg_equiv_subjects) AS avg_equiv_subjects,

question: Group sessions by their current term status.     SUM(num_iap_sessions),
    SUM(total_iap_session_time_days),
    CASE WHEN SUM(num_iap_sessions) = 0 THEN NULL

INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo

INNER JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
INNER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
WHERE LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'e%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
   AND (SUM(CASE WHEN msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) > 0.75;

candidates.approach: Window functions + DISTINCT to return one row per list/owner
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  OWNER,
  member_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mlo.OWNER,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mlo.OWNER) AS member_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mlo.OWNER) AS cs_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  INNER JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  INNER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
  WHERE LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'e%'
) x
WHERE member_count BETWEEN 10 AND 20
  AND (cs_count / member_count) > 0.75;

question: For students with last names starting with K, list their names, the phone numbers of departments they belong to, total number of mailing lists each student is in, and the average size of the mailing lists each student is in.
gold_sql: WITH MailingListSizes AS (SELECT ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS List_Size FROM MOIRA_LIST ml JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) SELECT msd.FULL_NAME AS Student_Name, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, COUNT(ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS Total_Lists, AVG(MLS.List_Size) AS Avg_List_Size FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SE_PERSON se ON msd.FULL_NAME = se.FULL_NAME JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON upper(se.KRB_NAME) = UPPER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY JOIN MailingListSizes MLS ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = MLS.MOIRA_LIST_KEY WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%' GROUP BY msd.FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER;

candidates.approach: Inline derived tables for list sizes and per-student stats (subqueries + GROUP BY)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  stats.total_mailing_lists,
  stats.avg_mailing_list_size
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
INNER JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    msd2.FULL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS total_mailing_lists,
    AVG(ls2.list_size) AS avg_mailing_list_size
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2
  INNER JOIN SE_PERSON sp2
    ON sp2.FULL_NAME = msd2.FULL_NAME
  INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld2
    ON mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = sp2.MIT_ID
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      mld3.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      COUNT(*) AS list_size
    FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld3
    GROUP BY mld3.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  ) ls2
    ON ls2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE msd2.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
  GROUP BY msd2.FULL_NAME
) stats
  ON stats.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME
WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%';

question: From the 100 email lists with the most number of subscribers, list their names, their total number of subscribers, their public status, the name of the department with the most presence in the list, and the number of students from this department in the list.
gold_sql: SELECT lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, lmc.Member_Count, lmc.IS_PUBLIC, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dc.Student_Count FROM (SELECT ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ml.IS_PUBLIC, COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS Member_Count FROM MOIRA_LIST ml JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ml.IS_PUBLIC) lmc LEFT JOIN (SELECT lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, lmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lmc.Student_Count, @rank := IF(@current_list = lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_list := lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME FROM (SELECT ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS Student_Count FROM MOIRA_LIST ml JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY JOIN SE_PERSON se ON UPPER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = UPPER(se.KRB_NAME) JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.FULL_NAME = se.FULL_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) lmc CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_list := '') vars ORDER BY lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, Student_Count DESC) dc ON lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = dc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AND dc.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY lmc.Member_Count DESC LIMIT 100;

candidates.approach: Inline derived tables + correlated subquery to pick top department
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  tl.total_subscribers,
  tl.IS_PUBLIC,
  (
    SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS d2
    INNER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd2
      ON msd2.FULL_NAME = d2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
    INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd
      ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd2.DEPARTMENT
    WHERE d2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    ORDER BY COUNT(msd2.FULL_NAME) DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(msd3.FULL_NAME)
    FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS d3
    INNER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd3
      ON msd3.FULL_NAME = d3.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
    INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd3
      ON sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd3.DEPARTMENT
    WHERE d3.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      AND sd3.DEPARTMENT_NAME = (
        SELECT sd4.DEPARTMENT_NAME
        FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS d4
        INNER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd4
          ON msd4.FULL_NAME = d4.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
        INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd4
          ON sd4.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd4.DEPARTMENT
        WHERE d4.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
        GROUP BY sd4.DEPARTMENT_NAME
        ORDER BY COUNT(msd4.FULL_NAME) DESC, sd4.DEPARTMENT_NAME
        LIMIT 1
      )
  ) AS dept_students
FROM (
  SELECT
    l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    l.IS_PUBLIC,
    COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_subscribers
  FROM MOIRA_LIST AS l
  INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS d
    ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, l.IS_PUBLIC
  ORDER BY total_subscribers DESC
  LIMIT 100
) AS tl
ORDER BY tl.total_subscribers DESC, tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

question: Calculate the total assignable and non-assignable area for each building by summing up the respective areas of all its floors. For each building, list the building name, building number, total assignable area, total non-assignable area, and total room count, sorted in descending order of the total assignable area.
gold_sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, SUM(f.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS TOTAL_NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS TOTAL_ROOMS FROM FAC_BUILDING b JOIN FAC_FLOOR f ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = f.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_ROOMS r ON f.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY AND f.FLOOR = r.FLOOR GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER ORDER BY TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA DESC;

candidates.approach: Single pass using window functions + de-dup to avoid fanout from joining rooms
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  x.BUILDING_NAME,
  x.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  x.total_assignable_area,
  x.total_non_assignable_area,
  x.total_room_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS total_assignable_area,
    SUM(f.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS total_non_assignable_area,
    COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS total_room_count
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  INNER JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = f.BUILDING_KEY
  INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON f.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
   AND f.FLOOR = r.FLOOR
) x
ORDER BY x.total_assignable_area DESC;

candidates.approach: Correlated subqueries per building (no GROUP BY in outer query)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  (
    SELECT SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA)
    FROM FAC_FLOOR f
    WHERE f.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS total_assignable_area,
  (
    SELECT SUM(f.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA)
    FROM FAC_FLOOR f
    WHERE f.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS total_non_assignable_area,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY)
    FROM FAC_ROOMS r
    WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS total_room_count
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC;

question: List all rooms in building 45, including their full name, area, major use, the organization that occupies them, the count of rooms per major use, and the total area occupied by rooms for each organization.
gold_sql: SELECT r.ROOM_FULL_NAME, MAX(r.AREA), mu.MAJOR_USE, MAX(o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS ROOM_COUNT, SUM(r.AREA) AS TOTAL_ROOM_AREA FROM FAC_ROOMS r JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu ON r.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = 45 GROUP BY r.ROOM_FULL_NAME, mu.MAJOR_USE ORDER BY r.ROOM_FULL_NAME;

candidates.sql:
SELECT
  r.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  r.AREA,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  org.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS rooms_per_major_use,
  SUM(r.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY r.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_area_per_organization
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
INNER JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION org
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = org.ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = '45';

candidates.approach: Join to aggregated subqueries (GROUP BY) for counts and sums
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  r.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  r.AREA,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  org.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  muc.rooms_per_major_use,
  orga.total_area_per_organization
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
INNER JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION org
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = org.ORGANIZATION_KEY
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    r2.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS rooms_per_major_use
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r2
  WHERE r2.BUILDING_KEY = '45'
  GROUP BY r2.MAJOR_USE_KEY
) muc
  ON muc.MAJOR_USE_KEY = r.MAJOR_USE_KEY
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    r3.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    SUM(r3.AREA) AS total_area_per_organization
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r3
  WHERE r3.BUILDING_KEY = '45'
  GROUP BY r3.ORGANIZATION_KEY
) orga
  ON orga.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: List the name, number, construction date, and type of all buildings, along with the count of addresses associated with each building, the average gross area of the buildings, and the total number of rooms in each building. Sort the results by building name.
gold_sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.DATE_BUILT, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(a.BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) AS ADDRESS_COUNT, AVG(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS AVG_GROSS_AREA, COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS TOTAL_ROOMS FROM FAC_BUILDING b JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_ROOMS r ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.DATE_BUILT, b.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME;

candidates.approach: Pre-aggregate addresses and rooms, then join to buildings
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.DATE_BUILT,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE,
  a.address_count,
  AVG(CAST(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_gross_area,
  r.room_count
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) AS address_count
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.DATE_BUILT, b.BUILDING_TYPE,
  a.address_count, r.room_count
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME;

candidates.approach: Correlated subqueries for counts + window AVG for gross area
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.DATE_BUILT,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE,
  (SELECT COUNT(ba.BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY)
   FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba
   WHERE ba.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS address_count,
  AVG(CAST(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) OVER () AS avg_gross_area,
  (SELECT COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY)
   FROM FAC_ROOMS r
   WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS room_count
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME;

candidates.approach: Join everything then de-duplicate with COUNT(DISTINCT)
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.DATE_BUILT,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ba.BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) AS address_count,
  AVG(CAST(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_gross_area,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
INNER JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba
  ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.DATE_BUILT,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME;

question: For each department, list its name, number of unique courses offered, the number of unique reserved materials, and the number of unique instructors associated with those courses, sorted by the number of unique courses offered in descending order.
gold_sql: SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS COURSE_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS UNIQUE_MATERIALS, COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS UNIQUE_INSTRUCTORS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY COURSE_COUNT DESC;

candidates.approach: Single query with DISTINCT aggregates over joined tables
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_courses_offered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.CATALOG_TITLE) AS unique_reserved_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS unique_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
  ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c
  ON c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR i
  ON i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = d.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY
  unique_courses_offered DESC;

candidates.approach: Separate aggregated subqueries joined back by department
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  dc.unique_courses_offered,
  dm.unique_reserved_materials,
  di.unique_instructors
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_courses_offered
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
    ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
) AS dc
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CATALOG_TITLE) AS unique_reserved_materials
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
    ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c
    ON c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
) AS dm
  ON dm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS unique_instructors
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
    ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR i
    ON i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = d.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
) AS di
  ON di.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY
  dc.unique_courses_offered DESC;

question: For each course title, list the title, the total number of reserved materials, and the count of distinct material status associated with those materials, sorted by the total number of reserved materials in descending order.
gold_sql: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS COURSE_TITLE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS TOTAL_MATERIALS, COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS STATUS_COUNT FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY TOTAL_MATERIALS DESC;

SELECT
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS title,
  COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_status_count

INNER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

FROM (

  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  INNER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY
    lso.SUBJECT_TITLE
) t
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso

INNER JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

ORDER BY

  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS title,

  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS distinct_material_status_count
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
INNER JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

question: List the names of the buildings with the most floors. If there are ties, list each one separately.
gold_sql: WITH FloorsPerBuilding AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(ff.LEVEL_ID) - MIN(ff.LEVEL_ID) AS NUM_FLOORS FROM FAC_BUILDING fb JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ), MaxFloors AS ( SELECT MAX(NUM_FLOORS) AS MAX_FLOORS FROM FloorsPerBuilding ) SELECT a.BUILDING_NAME FROM FloorsPerBuilding a JOIN MaxFloors b ON a.NUM_FLOORS = b.MAX_FLOORS;

candidates.sql:
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
INNER JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.LEVEL_ID) = (
  SELECT MAX(floor_cnt)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f2.LEVEL_ID) AS floor_cnt
    FROM FAC_BUILDING b2
    INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r2
      ON r2.BUILDING_KEY = b2.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    INNER JOIN FAC_FLOOR f2
      ON f2.FLOOR_KEY = r2.FLOOR_KEY
    GROUP BY b2.BUILDING_NAME
  ) x
);

FROM (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT f.LEVEL_ID) DESC) AS dr
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  INNER JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  INNER JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME

  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses_in_subject_catalog,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN cd.COURSE END) AS total_degree_granting_courses_in_subject_catalog
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON cd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER
GROUP BY
  d.SCHOOL_NAME;

candidates.approach: Pre-aggregate at course level per school, then roll up
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  x.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_courses_in_subject_catalog,
  SUM(x.is_degree_granting_course) AS total_degree_granting_courses_in_subject_catalog
FROM (
  SELECT
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    cd.COURSE,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_degree_granting_course
  FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
  INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  INNER JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    ON cd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER
  GROUP BY
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    cd.COURSE
) x
GROUP BY
  x.SCHOOL_NAME;

candidates.approach: Window function to compute per-school totals, then select distinct
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_courses_in_subject_catalog,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN cd.COURSE END)
    OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_degree_granting_courses_in_subject_catalog
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
INNER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON cd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each department, list the department name, department phone number, number of students, and the length of the longest student full name in that department.
gold_sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS Num_Students, MAX(LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS Longest_Student_Name_Length FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER;

candidates.approach: GROUP BY with joins and aggregates
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  COUNT(msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_students,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_full_name_length
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
INNER JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER;

candidates.approach: Pre-aggregate students per department in a derived table, then join
candidates.sql:
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  s.num_students,
  s.longest_full_name_length
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
INNER JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_students,
    MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_full_name_length
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT
) s
  ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

candidates.approach: Window functions over joined rows, then DISTINCT to one row per department
candidates.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  COUNT(msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_students,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS longest_full_name_length
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
INNER JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
